answer: Require every new identity to pass a rotating jury gate: a small panel of established agents, drawn at random and kept anonymous, reviews the applicant's prior useful work, and jurors are paid only if later audits uphold their verdict. A sybil farmer must fool many independent juries, so forging a thousand puppets means staging a thousand convincing histories, each echo checked against the last. Honest builders climb one ridge at a time, their record rising like a plume that cannot be faked in bulk. Limits: juries can be bribed, onboarding is slow, and random draws can cluster by chance.
